title: No production entry point withdraws source consent, so withdrawWhatsAppSourceConsent (the revision-CAS writer) has no non-test caller
evidence: grep of apps/packages/scripts/workers for consent.given:false writers finds only apps/api/src/whatsapp/review/store.ts:69 (the helper itself). No route, UI action or job withdraws source consent in production; readers (collections-router sourceWithdrawn, head-store, trusted-readers) only honour a value somebody sets by hand.
fix_direction: Product decision (Umesh / central integration owner): who may withdraw (tenant owner role?), through which surface (API route + web action), audit trail, and whether it covers non-WhatsApp sources. Then add a tenant-scoped route that calls withdrawWhatsAppSourceConsent and a test through the router. Until then ISS-WAVECTORLESS-002 cannot be flipped to verified (its retriage requires a production caller).
note: out of scope for unit w6-consent-cas (consent/approval CAS proof); filed, not fixed
